name: NEWS-G
summary: NEWS-G uses low-threshold spherical proportional counters to search for light dark matter, through a Modane prototype and a low-background detector at SNOLAB. Spherical geometry permits a large gas volume with very low readout capacitance.
detection_principle: Particles ionize the gas; electrons drift in a radial electric field to a central sensor and undergo avalanche amplification. Pulse timing provides position and event-type information.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
